item.title: Orchestration or choreography?
item.description:
One fibre order. Three services: inventory, billing, field technicians.
Who decides what happens next? And who reacts when the technician step fails?
Two answers: a conductor that calls each service in order (orchestration), or services that listen to events and react on their own (choreography). Same goal, very different trade-offs.
Conductor or dancers: which does your team use?
